thread:
alex.pm: Quick sync — final go-live prep for inference-v2. Need clear owners for SLA writeup, runbook, observability alerts, and pricing confirmation by EOD Fri.

maria-eng: I can take runtime docs + canary plan. Will post canary percentages and rollout steps later today.

jon-sre: I’ll own the SLA draft and SLO target numbers. Proposal: 99.9% monthly availability, p95 latency < 120ms for common routes. Thoughts?

tess-docs: I’ll start a short quickstart + migration notes. Need the final list of endpoints and error codes from eng.

sam-support: Support runbook checklist: escalation path, known degradations, customer workaround for degraded KV cache. Can one of you drop the exact fallback behavior?

olivia-ops: Observability owners — I’ll wire up dashboards and alerts. Questions: what do we want alerted as "urgent"? Error budget burn, model mismatch rate > 2%, or request queue > 80%?

luis-qa: Canary validation criteria: 48h stable, error rate within 0.1% of baseline, latency drift < 10ms. Also need synthetic traffic harness.

maria-eng: Fallback behavior: when KV cache misses exceed threshold we fall back to non-cached inference (slower), and we automatically switch to a smaller model variant if GPU queue > 200ms for 60s. Will document exact flags: `--force-variant=small` and `cache_threshold=0.2`.

jon-sre: OK on SLOs. Add recovery SLAs: mean time to rollback < 15m for config-only failures, < 2h for model binary issues. I’ll put that in the draft.

tess-docs: For API surface, list of endpoints needed: `/v1/generate`, `/v1/chat`, `/v1/embeddings`, plus admin rollback endpoint. Whoever owns admin endpoint confirm name.

sam-support: Can we get a one-pager with pageable playbook steps? I'd rather avoid deep links in runbook for first 24h.

olivia-ops: Alerts labeled P0: total 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, GPU OOMs, model crash loop. P1: p95 latency > 200ms for 10m, error budget burn. I'll prepare alert trees.

luis-qa: Will run chaos test on canary in staging today — CPU/GPU flaps + network spikes. Results by EOD.

alex.pm: Pricing/monetization check — finance needs final unit rates + reserved capacity tiers. Who's tracking that?

maria-eng: I'll sync with finance & pricing on the SKU names. Need to confirm quantization delta guidance (e.g., quantized-8 vs fp16 quality note) for docs.

jon-sre: Also add audit log requirement for Private deployments — compliance wants immutable request logs for 90 days. Ops to confirm storage size impact.

tess-docs: Docs TODO: quickstart, migration, canary checklist, troubleshooting, SLA page, pricing matrix. I’ll create stub pages now and link them once assets exist.

sam-support: One more: post-launch 48h on-call rota — product + eng + sRE + support on first line. Who volunteers nights Fri-Sun?

olivia-ops: I can cover ops nights Sat/Sun as backup. Need 2 primary volunteers.

maria-eng: I’ll cover Fri night.

alex.pm: Owners recap: SLA — jon-sre; Runtime & canary plan — maria-eng; Docs — tess-docs; Support runbook — sam-support; Observability — olivia-ops; QA harness — luis-qa; Pricing sync — maria-eng + finance. Action: please drop check-ins in this thread w/ updates.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: inference-v2 canary -> us-west-2 10% at 2023-11-09T02:00Z (automated), rollback window 48h.

luis-qa: Dropping canary test plan link: https://internal.qa/canary/inference-v2 (will update with results).

alex.pm: Thanks — if anyone can't meet their owner commit, flag here so we can reassign. We want a clean handoff to oncall + support docs before the canary kicks off."
